name: Shoko Relay
overview: A custom metadata provider and automation toolset for integrating Plex and AnimeThemes with Shoko Server.

releases.release_notes:
Further fixes related to Plex Server changes from [CVE-2026-96655](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9x88-w2p7-56vh)

**Changes:**
- Modified the image upload method in PlexCollections.cs to utilise direct file stream uploads preventing DNS/networking errors on restricted networks
- Updated CollectionService.cs to supply raw file paths to the Plex API and remove the legacy NormalizeCacheUrl helper
- Added hidden RequireSubtitleLanguageCodes advanced setting

**Contributions:**
* @Foowy in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/21

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.0...v0.21.1

A small but breaking change has been made in the abstractions which should help to enhance cast deduplication performance.

**Changes:**
- Enhance FindMatchingTmdbEntry to compare whitespace-stripped AniDB OriginalName values against whitespace-stripped TMDB OriginalName and TMDB AlternativeNames as high-priority fast paths
- Remove the AniDB `AlternativeNames` check, as Shoko doesn't populate alternate names for AniDB creators
- Implement a 5th pass in `FindMatchingTmdbEntry` to compare AniDB's romanised Name (and its flipped variant) against TMDB AlternativeNames (and their flipped variants) to ensure accurate fallback matching
- Read a creator's and a character's name from `Title`, their original name from `OriginalTitle` and their other names from `Titles`, now that `Name`, `OriginalName` and `AlternativeNames` are gone
- Implement case-insensitive, whitespace-ignoring deduplication for studio tags via `DistinctBy` in `GetStudioTags`
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.108


**Contributions:**
* @revam in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/20

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.20.2...v0.21.0

Following Plex Server changes due to [CVE-2026-96655](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9x88-w2p7-56vh) cast & crew images must now be sourced from publicly available URLs rather than from Shoko. Due to this change TMDB is now the preferred provider for these images by default (to avoid strict AniDB HTTP limits). Therefore, it is highly recommended that TMDB cast information/images are enabled in Shoko Server.

**Changes:**
- Enabled forceRemote for cast and crew images in CastHelper to bypass Plex's caller-supplied URL restrictions
- Added TmdbCastImages setting to RelayConfig to allow preferring TMDB images for cast and crew
- Implemented robust name matching hierarchy (OriginalName, Name, Flipped Name, and AlternativeNames) in CastHelper
- Applied deduplication and TMDB image resolution to both cast and crew entries within GetCastAndCrew
- Implemented CleanCrewRole helper to strip department prefixes from crew job titles to prevent truncation in Plex UI
- Added VideoUserDataSaveReason.PlaybackProgress for episode playback tracking
- Bumped Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.107

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.20.1...v0.20.2

This release migrates the image management, logging and background automations within the plugin to use native solutions that are now provided by Shoko.Abstractions. Due to these changes anyone who was using the original Plex Image Sync method can run `/shoko/purge-all-custom-images` in swagger and then safely delete `images_shokorelay.cache` from the config folder (as the cache file is now obsolete).

**Changes:**
- Migrate background automation to Shoko's native Scheduled Actions system
- Migrate logging from NLog to native Microsoft.Extensions.Logging using structured message templates
- Migrate image management to native Shoko metadata sources to explicitly track ownership
- Separate local asset and Plex thumbnail metadata sources to prevent purge loops
- Optimize `SourceLinkService` to trigger targeted Shoko file scans upon symlink generation
- Optimize performance and reduce memory allocations by utilizing compile-time `[GeneratedRegex]` source generators
- Optimize TMDB metadata lookups and preferred episode orderings with bulk caching to significantly reduce database queries
- Force remote HTTPS CDN URLs for preview thumbnails to bypass browser Mixed Content blocks in Plex's "Fix Match" UI
- Refactor and compress the Plex match endpoint logic
- Resolve a potential race condition in the VFS watcher queue
- Sort AnimeThemes mapping report logs chronologically by year/decade
- Standardize parameter naming, XML documentation, and JSDoc across the entire codebase
- Gracefully handle task cancellation during server shutdown to prevent noisy console errors
- Update README to clarify Plex's native collection assignment framework and Shoko's live file watcher exclusion rules
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.100

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.20.0...v0.20.1

Another set of significant changes has been made in the abstractions, but just like last time core functionality for the plugin should remain the same.

**Changes:**
- Added `ShokoRelay.Vfs` to global using directives in `.csproj`
- Added memory caching for `plex.token` as well as various other tweaks and adjustments
- Replaced deprecated stylelint-config-concentric step with prettier-plugin-css-order in lint-format.yml
- Bumped `Shoko.Abstractions` to `6.0.0-alpha.98`

**Contributions:**
* @revam in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/16

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.19.1...v0.20.0

**Changes:**
- Parse the requested 'type', 'index', and 'parentIndex' properties from Plex match requests
- Dynamically return Show, Season, or Episode metadata objects from the /matches endpoint to satisfy Plex's native scanner
- Allow DeferVfsCreationUntilFixup to delay VFS symlink creation even when Plex is not authenticated
- Extract plugin identity metadata from constants in project file
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.97
- Minor README.md Tweaks
- Update plugin icon

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.19.0...v0.19.1

A lot has changed in the abstractions this time around but core functionality for the plugin should remain the same.

**Changes:**
- Bump `Shoko.Abstractions` to `6.0.0-alpha.95`
- Update `lint-format.yml` to prevent it from always failing

**Contributions:**
* @revam in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/15

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.18.1...v0.19.0

This should be the last release before a fairly large update to Shoko.Abstractions on the server side.

**Changes:**
- Implemented a rating key polling loop in `RunMetadataFixupAsync` for the deferred VFS mode to ensure automations wait for Plex indexing to complete.
- Bypassed redundant forced metadata refreshes when `Defer VFS Creation` is enabled, unless `Force Partial Scans` is active.
- Buffered image synchronization in deferred mode using `PlexScanDelay` to prevent missing thumbnail errors during Plex's native extraction.
- Optimized rating key polling to skip irrelevant library targets (e.g., checking Movie libraries for TV shows).
- Extracted `GetMatchingTargetsForPath` to dry up path resolution and accurately target specific Plex library sections.
- Increased the default `PlexScanDelay` to 10 seconds and implemented dynamic polling retry scaling to maintain a fixed timeout window.
- Enhanced `VfsWatcher` logs to include `target.Title` for clearer diagnostics on multi-library servers.
- Embedded a plugin icon for the Shoko WebUI via `EmbeddedIconResourceName` and migrated the plugin manifest to use `thumbnail_url`.
- Updated dashboard help documentation and simplified the "Defer VFS Creation" setting name.
- Updated `Shoko.Abstractions` to `6.0.0-alpha.94`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.18.0...v0.18.1

**Changes:**
- Update BuildSimilarArray in PlexMetadata to use the new `Suggestions` property instead of `Similar`
- Safeguard metadata endpoints against Shoko.Abstractions mismatches
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.93

**New Contributors:**
* @Foowy made their first contribution in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/14

> This release was mistakenly released as v0.17.6 a week ago and has been reposted with the corrected version number
